brief.en: Give NAPA-2 a power margin of at least 10 % at the end of its life, the battery drained no deeper than 30 %, and type its longest eclipse.

brief.en: Keep the THEOS-2-class imager up for its ten years and down within IADC's 25, bring 100 Gbit down to Bangkok a day, and type its swath.
